minimal_callable_path: from model import ModelWrapper; result = ModelWrapper().predict({"enroll_audio": <fixture>, "trial_audio": <fixture>})
exact_commands_or_callable_steps: Create a fresh temporary working directory and copy src/sure_eval/models/wespeaker/repro_bundle into it.
Run src/sure_eval/models/wespeaker/setup.sh with SURE_WESPEAKER_VENV_DIR pointed inside the new temp directory.
Set PYTHONPATH to the model directory so the temp environment imports the validated model-local wrapper files.
Call ModelWrapper().predict(...) with the tiny enroll/trial fixture paths from repro_bundle/fixtures/.
Confirm the JSON output contains the required finite score fields.
working_directory_assumptions: The replay must run from a fresh temporary directory, not from the phase-1 working directory.
The model-local wrapper files remain at src/sure_eval/models/wespeaker/ and are imported via PYTHONPATH.
The tiny fixture files are copied into the temp directory from repro_bundle/fixtures/.
required_inputs: A Python 3.10 interpreter or a compatible interpreter accepted by setup.sh.
The model-local checkpoints directory recorded in weights_manifest.json.
The reference wrapper files under repro_bundle/reference/.
